ThingDef.Name: BelicoseAPBase
ThingDef.description: A .45-caliber armor-piercing pistol cartridge developed by Belicose for the Mark 17. Subsonic, heavy, designed to defeat human carapace at close range. Designated the .45 Belicose AP by the manufacturer. Inferior to Mechanoid-grade armor.

RecipeDef.label: make Belicose AP (HP) x50
RecipeDef.description: Craft 50 Belicose AP hollow point cartridges.

ThingDef.Name: XMP7MicroBase
ThingDef.description: A 4x18mm sub-caliber micro-flechette developed through PROJECT: VOLLEY. Tiny enough to allow near-zero recoil in 7-round bursts from the Mithras XMP-7. Effective against flesh, negligible against armor.

ThingDef.Name: MicroMunitionsBase
ThingDef.description: A 5x28mm proprietary PDW cartridge produced by Micro-Munitions. High-velocity, compact, designed for the Micro-Munitions Protector. Used by the Presidium Guard as a concealed sidearm round. No equivalent in the standard CE caliber registry.

ThingDef.Name: Base570Express
ThingDef.description: A .570-caliber (14.5mm) large-bore revolver cartridge developed by Belicose for the EVA Argonaut. One of the most powerful handgun cartridges in existence, delivering extreme stopping power at the cost of severe recoil and low magazine capacity. Favored by void-farers who need a sidearm capable of stopping large threats in a single shot.

ThingDef.Name: Base16x50mm
ThingDef.description: A 16.5x50mm light cannon cartridge developed for the Alexandria Type-22 Double Deuce. Anti-vehicle capable, filling the gap between 12.7x99mm (.50 BMG) and 20x102mm autocannon rounds. Designed to defeat armored personnel carriers and light aircraft. Heavier than any rifle caliber in the CE standard registry.

ThingDef.Name: Base6x24mmPhased
ThingDef.description: A 6x24mm phased electric projectile developed by Alphamech for the Apollo-97 system. Electrically propelled through phased magnetic coils rather than chemical propellant. While sharing the 6x24mm designation with CE's standard Charged Rifle rounds, these are electrically-phased and carry different ammo classes — EMP, Shock, and AP variants not available in the standard charge rifle set.

ThingDef.Name: Base10Gauge
ThingDef.description: A 10-gauge caseless shell produced by Millenia for the M72 Super-Shotgun and licensed to Tschish-Maxwell for the Coreburner. Larger bore than the standard 12-gauge (41.4g payload), the 10-gauge caseless carries approximately 55g of shot or slug material. Not compatible with standard 12-gauge weapons.

ThingDef.Name: BaseFlechette
ThingDef.description: A 3x45mm sub-caliber flechette dart designed by Terys-Gua for the R4 Shredder. The 3mm steel dart and 45mm sabot casing deliver extreme soft-tissue damage at the cost of armor penetration. Developed specifically to fight the unarmored clone armies of the Black King on the fortress-world of Sisu. Not compatible with standard 5.56x45mm weapons.

ThingDef.Name: BaseChemRail
ThingDef.description: A .60-caliber (15.24mm) hybrid slug developed for the Alphamech Gustav Mod.10 Chem-Rail. Launched by chemical propellant and then accelerated through magnetic rails, these rounds sit between .50 BMG (12.7mm) and 20mm autocannon (20mm) in bore diameter. The chemical-rail hybrid launch mechanism gives them a distinct ballistic profile from either pure chemical or pure magnetic propulsion systems.

ThingDef.Name: BaseHypervelocityAMR
ThingDef.description: A .50-caliber (12.7mm) hypervelocity kinetic penetrator developed on Okeus for the OMC-2 Twin Lancer. While sharing bore diameter with .50 BMG, these rounds are purpose-designed for rail-assisted hypervelocity launch — lighter projectile, harder alloy, no explosive filler. Velocity exceeds all standard CE calibers. Incompatible with conventional .50 BMG chambers due to different case geometry and chamber pressure ratings.
